name: github-source-links
goal: Source tabs show only safe GitHub file links pinned to the selected revision

evidence: Source becomes only commit-pinned GitHub file links, with optional canonical repository metadata and no internal ownership fields.

Existing source rendering and responsive navigation cases assert only visible file text. Strengthened the same cases for link destination, revision scope, absence of metadata and unavailable repository; index coverage checks SSH/HTTPS normalization.
Committed assertions reproduce missing repository metadata and GitHub file links. Tightened unavailable-link assertion to ignore unrelated app-route links.
Source renders only validated GitHub file links at the selected full commit. Index carries a canonical repository URL from Git origin.
The same committed index, component rendering and responsive navigation regressions pass at 276f672b with unchanged test inputs and environment.
